import json, subprocess, sys, os

                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=e, cwd='/workspace/tmp')
    outs.append((seed, p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr[:200]))
print('returncodes', [o[1] for o in outs])
print('stderr', [o[3] for o in outs if o[3]][:1])
print('all identical:', len({o[2] for o in outs}) == 1, 'bytes', len(outs[0][2]))
